author: RAFAEL MELO REIS
purpose: Model observed dispersion as a time-dependent mixture of populations with different origin, age, velocity, residence/capture history, intervening medium, projection and selection effects, without silently adding parameters to the canonical RLL likelihood.

core_hypothesis.statement: An observed field can contain superposed populations that arrived from different regions and epochs with different velocity distributions; some objects may be captured, delayed, migrated or retained, so present position or apparent ring/shell membership does not imply common origin or common age.
core_hypothesis.mixture_likelihood: p(y_i|Theta)=sum_k pi_k * integral p(y_i|z_i,k,Theta) p(z_i|k,Theta) dz_i
core_hypothesis.dispersion_decomposition: Sigma_obs = Sigma_measurement + Sigma_intrinsic + Sigma_origin + Sigma_transport + Sigma_medium + Sigma_projection + cross_covariances
core_hypothesis.selection_rule: selection/visibility is modeled in the likelihood normalization or explicit selection operator; it is not automatically an additive covariance term
core_hypothesis.complexity_rule: A new parameter is admitted only if it has a declared domain, unit, prior, source or model authority, falsifier and preregistered comparison. More observations do not by themselves authorize more free parameters.

strong_gravity_specialization.projective_observable: b_obs = F_GR(M,a_star,i,D,emission_model) + Delta_b_medium + Delta_b_projection + Delta_b_systematics + Delta_b_RLL
strong_gravity_specialization.boundary: Delta_b_RLL remains TOKEN_VAZIO until the GR+plasma+projection baseline is fitted and held-out residual structure survives covariance-aware tests.

cosmology_specialization.rule: The population-dispersion layer is initially an observation/heterogeneity model. It must not be inserted into H(z) or promoted to a new cosmological density component without an explicit equation-of-motion/continuity bridge and model-selection evidence.

intervening_space_inventory.boundary: Intergalactic/interstellar space is not observationally empty, but intervening matter/plasma must not be relabelled as evidence for a new quantum-vacuum component.

earth_deep_water.safe_use: Methodological analogy: directly visible surface inventory can be smaller than or structurally different from hidden reservoirs inferred or sampled through independent probes.
earth_deep_water.forbidden_use: Earth water reservoirs are not evidence for dark matter, dark energy, RLL vacuum constituents or black-hole interior contents.

offshore_freshened_groundwater.safe_use: Observed example of a hidden, spatially distributed reservoir whose age, origin, flow history and present location differ.
offshore_freshened_groundwater.forbidden_use: Do not equate sub-seafloor freshwater with mantle water or with cosmological vacuum structure.

exoplanet_architecture.safe_use: Observed planetary architectures can evolve with age; age and migration can therefore be legitimate latent variables in planetary-population models.
exoplanet_architecture.forbidden_use: Planetary evolution does not establish the RLL cosmological sector.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: DESI DR2 Results IV: Alcock-Paczynski Measurements from the Lyman Alpha Forest and Cosmological Constraints
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Full-shape Ly-alpha AP constrains geometry at z_eff=2.33 and demonstrates that additional information can shift extended-model inferences; use as a data/model-comparison anchor, not as automatic permission for extra RLL parameters.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Extended Dark Energy analysis using DESI DR2 BAO measurements
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Broad parametric and non-parametric tests found a two-parameter w(z) extension sufficient to capture the main trend; complexity must be justified, not accumulated.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Age dependence of the occurrence and architecture of ultra-short-period planet systems
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Planet-system architecture shows age dependence, supporting age/evolution as legitimate latent variables in that domain.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Fundamental relations for the velocity dispersion of stars in the Milky Way
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Velocity dispersion depends jointly on age, angular momentum, metallicity and height above the plane; supports multivariate population treatment for Galactic kinematics.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Hydrous mantle transition zone indicated by ringwoodite included within diamond
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Direct evidence that at least local mantle-transition-zone material can be hydrous; not a global ocean-volume equality.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Water Reservoirs in the Lower Mantle Beneath Northeastern Asia
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Supports deep-Earth water-reservoir investigation and heterogeneity; does not establish a single global reservoir volume.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Offshore freshened groundwater in the Pearl River estuary and shelf as a significant water resource
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Direct borehole/geochemical evidence for extensive freshened groundwater beneath the seafloor on a continental shelf.

recent_evidence_anchors.title: Origin of the elliptical ring structure in M87*
recent_evidence_anchors.use: Ring ellipticity depends on astrophysical and imaging effects and is not a one-parameter spin proxy; motivates explicit nuisance/systematics terms in strong-gravity projection tests.

gates: GATE_SOURCE: every promoted parameter has source_ref or model authority
GATE_UNITS: every promoted parameter has explicit units/dimension
GATE_PRIOR: prior is declared before fitting
GATE_SELECTION: selection model is separate from covariance
GATE_COVARIANCE: correlations are not reduced to diagonal unless justified
GATE_BASELINE: LCDM/GR/standard population baseline runs first
GATE_COMPLEXITY: compare information criteria and/or Bayesian evidence/cross-validation
GATE_HELDOUT: residual structure must survive held-out or posterior-predictive checks
GATE_CAUSALITY: present location does not imply origin without a transport model
GATE_CROSS_DOMAIN: analogy never promotes a physical parameter across domains
falsifiers: A one-population baseline explains the data after full covariance and selection treatment.
Added mixture components collapse to zero weight or become prior-dominated.
Age/origin/velocity effects disappear under measurement-error and selection corrections.
Residual improvements vanish on held-out data or independent reproduction.
Strong-gravity residuals disappear after plasma, scattering, imaging and epoch systematics are modeled.
A proposed RLL parameter is numerically redundant with an existing nuisance parameter.
Complexity penalties remove apparent preference for the extended model.
F_ok: user hypothesis translated into typed latent population, transport, residence, medium, projection and selection variables
recent DESI, planetary, Galactic-kinematic, deep-Earth and offshore-groundwater evidence routed with domain boundaries
strong-gravity specialization defined without identifying a projective image with a black-hole interior
F_gap: full covariance/cross-covariance authority for each target dataset
F_next: Run a synthetic two-or-more-population hidden-truth benchmark first; then bind one real domain at a time, beginning with strong-gravity projection or Galactic kinematics, before touching the canonical cosmological likelihood.
